title: Chinese companies are implementing "quiet" AI-driven layoffs to avoid labor laws that require government approval for job cuts exceeding 10% of a workforce (Laurie Chen/Reuters)
summary: Laurie Chen / Reuters: Chinese companies are implementing “quiet” AI-driven layoffs to avoid labor laws that require government approval for job cuts exceeding 10% of a workforce — Liu, a Hangzhou-based contractor at a large Chinese internet firm, says her employer began quietly firing contractors …
